content_html: Dr. Fang is selected as a 2026 Victor J. Dzau Emerging Leaders in Health and Medicine Scholar by the National Academy of Medicine — one of 10 scholars chosen nationwide. Term: July 2026 – June 2029.
Dr. Fang presents at the UF AI Day 2024 AI Winners Panel discussing AI across curriculum.
Dr. Fang is recognized as a "Rising Star" in the Academy of Science, Engineering and Medicine of Florida (ASEMFL) for her contributions in medical AI and deep learning models.
Dr. Fang receives Pruitt Family Endowed Faculty Fellow for 2023-2026!
